name: Cross App Access (ID-JAG)
summary: IETF OAuth draft (Identity Assertion JWT Authorization Grant) letting an app use an SSO identity assertion, via the trusted IdP, to get access tokens for a third-party API.
description: Coordinates through the identity provider the downstream resource authorization server already trusts for SSO, using Token Exchange. xaa.dev is a free, open sandbox for testing cross app access flows with ID-JAG.
